finding.headline: "The Naija Power-Supply Pump"
finding.problem: "The electric pump needs power. Light is gone half the day. If I'm engorged at night with no light, what then? Nobody's checklist mentions that generators don't help a pump."
finding.person: Nigerian mum considering an electric pump but has erratic NEPA/light supply; fears it won't charge when needed.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (Nigeria-specific feeding-equipment reality) — strong local differentiation.". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
